parsed.post: Keep: halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 improved val_bpb 0.925740 -> 0.913605 on depth 6 + all shards. Next testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize early training. Others: worth stacking warmup with small batch and depth 6.
parsed.description: Add 5% warmup on top of depth 6, batch 262144, and all 11 shards to test whether smoother early learning improves val_bpb.
